title: Morning Intel
bullets: Markets: S&P 500 +0.3% to 7,677, Nasdaq +0.6%, Dow +0.3%; 10-yr yield eased to 4.64% as oil sold off (Brent -3.9% to $88.58, WTI -3.1% to $82.36) on hopes the U.S. favors economic pressure over military action on Iran
Companies: Dick's Sporting Goods plunged ~30% on a weak outlook tied to soft sneaker demand at its Foot Locker business, dragging Nike, lululemon, Under Armour and Target lower too
Companies: Moderna jumped 14% on positive Phase 3 cancer-vaccine data
Companies: Anthropic is reportedly set to tell IPO investors it sees $30T+ in potential revenue opportunity, topping SpaceX's earlier $28.5T claim
Macro/Policy: Canada unveiled retaliatory tariffs (15%-50%) on ~$20B of U.S. goods effective Sept. 8, doubling existing U.S. steel/aluminum tariffs to 50% in response to U.S. trade action
Ahead: Wed 8/26 brings July PCE inflation (Fed's preferred gauge) plus Nvidia earnings after the bell; Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's Jackson Hole keynote lands Fri 8/28
